description: Hot Cross Buns (br09) models: a hot cross bun, a baking tray, a serving plate and a baker's hat for Robo. The oven is home_school.json `oven` (its door opens). Same format as ../models.json. Props face +z and stand on y = 0.

hot_cross_bun.description: A hot cross bun: a round, shiny golden-brown bun 0.24 m across and 0.13 m tall at size 1, with a raised white cross piped over the top (the arms run along x and z). Origin at the middle of its base. Tilt it (rotation [55, 0, 0]) to show the cross to a camera in front, e.g. as a HUD icon.

baker_tray.description: A metal baking tray 0.6 m wide (x) and 0.42 m deep at size 1, with a low rim and little end handles; its floor is at y 0.025, so buns parented to it sit at y 0.025 (two side by side at x ±0.14, or four at x ±0.14, z ±0.1).

bun_plate.description: A round toy plate 0.36 m across and 0.04 m tall at size 1: a white middle and a raised rim in the main colour (set color). A bun parented to it sits at [0, 0.03, 0].

baker_hat.description: A tall white baker's hat (a chef's toque): a band 0.4 m across and a puffy top, 0.42 m tall at size 1. Origin at the middle of the band's bottom; on Robo, parent it to robo at about [0, 1.6, 0].
